briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate AGI race as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs race toward AGI with new model releases amid rising geopolitical stakes. Funding surges while prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. Regulatory momentum builds slowly against compute buildouts.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with advanced reasoning; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus; Google releases Gemini 3; Meta open-sources Llama 4; xAI and DeepSeek accelerate in the latest benchmark wars.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: New exploits target multi-agent systems as prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for CAN bus, IoT and BCI.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm production for AI chips; Microsoft and Google announce $40B+ data center expansions in US and Asia. Energy constraints emerge in Texas and Singapore hubs.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-source models close the capability gap with closed labs before 2027?
